name: How long does window trim installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window trim installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window trim installation varies based on the number of windows, the complexity of the trim style, and the material chosen. A standard installation for a single window can often be completed within a few hours. For multiple windows or custom designs, the project may extend over several days. Our team can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific needs during a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window trim installation time varies by the number of windows, trim complexity, and material. A single window can take a few hours, while larger projects may take several days.
